comment: Source read at commit fcd92f3, the head of the repository and the only commit carrying the installed 2.0.0; its plugin.json is byte-identical to the installed one and all six res/ SVGs hash to the installed files. EVERY MUTE IS ON BY DEFAULT, SO THE MODULE IS SILENT WHEN IT IS PLACED. Adder.cpp:11 configures the seven row mutes with a default of 1.f and line 13 does the same for the overall mute, while process treats any value above 0 as muted (line 19 returns early, line 23 skips the row). The LedToggle SvgSwitch shows frame 1, the lit red lamp, at that value. The library screenshot shows them unlit because a widget with no module draws frame 0. The maker calls configParam with no name for any of the 22 parameters and calls neither configInput nor configOutput, so Rack shows an empty tooltip on every control and jack. The knobs and sign switches default to 1, which is a full level and a plus, so with the mutes off and nothing patched the output reads 7V.
